crossRefs.note: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”
Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him…
Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to…

translations.web: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”
translations.bsb: But I will also make a nation of the slave woman’s son, because he is your offspring.”
translations.kjv: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
translations.asv: And also of the son of the handmaid will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
